meta.title: MCP servers
meta.description: Manage DSH MCP servers in one place: global (DSH_HOME/yiklek/mcp.json) and workspace-level (<workspace>/.dsh/yiklek/mcp.json), with import/export for the mainstream config shapes.

title: MCP servers
subtitle: Connect external MCP servers; their tools reach the model as mcp__<name>__<tool>.

field.name: Name
field.nameHint: 1–32 characters: letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only

empty.project: This workspace has no MCP servers yet
empty.hint: Add one, or import an existing configuration

hint.renamed: This server is "{serverName}" in the profile because "{name}" was already taken
hint.shadowedByGlobal: Not in effect: a global server is also named "{name}", and the global definition wins. Delete or rename the global entry first.

error.nameDuplicate: Duplicate name in the same file: {name}
error.conflict: This configuration changed in another window. It has been reloaded; please review before saving again.

notice.wsEnabled: Workspace enabled (takes effect on the next start)
notice.wsDisabled: Workspace disabled; its MCP processes no longer start

effective.title: What DSH actually loads
effective.adopted: Picked up from the config file: {names}
effective.reloadHint: Some servers are not connected yet: if you just changed something, wait a moment or restart DSH.

ws.offHint: This workspace is switched off: its MCP servers do not start and its sessions cannot see them.

import.title: Import MCP configuration
import.hint: Accepts Claude Desktop / Cursor / VS Code / DSH native

export.title: Export MCP configuration
export.redact: Redact (replace every env/header value with ${env:KEY}; clear this to export a full backup)
export.omitted: This format cannot carry: {disabled} disabled server(s), {timeouts} timeout setting(s) — an export/import round trip loses both

drift.adopted: Picked up from the config file: {message}

external.title: Declared directly in the profile file
external.hint: These entries live in cordis.patch.yml and are not managed here. To manage one, move it into mcp.json and remove it from the patch file.

issue.name-invalid: A name must be 1–32 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen
issue.transport-invalid: Transport must be stdio or streamable-http
issue.command-required: A stdio server needs a command
issue.command-relative: The command looks like a relative path: {command} (prefer an absolute path or a global command)
issue.url-required: A streamable-http server needs a URL
issue.url-invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
issue.secret-inline: "{key}" looks like it contains a plaintext secret; prefer ${env:{key}}
issue.too-many-servers: A workspace may declare at most {max} servers (this one has {count}). Every project server spawns a process on every boot.
